title: It's not always clear from an item's own flavor text whether it's still 'live' for a quest elsewhere (tarnished locket's 'MAREN' name, the true founding record) versus purely a keepsake ('nothing is owed on it') — both phrasings look similar in the carry-list until you dig into status.
